title: Muharram
text: Muharram is the first month of the Islamic calendar and one of the four sacred months. Fasting on the Day of Ashura (10th Muharram) expiates the sins of the previous year (Sahih Muslim).

source: Qur'oni Karim (Baqara, 185 / Qadr) / Sahihi Buxoriy (38) va Muslim (760)
title: Ramadan
text: Ramadan is the month in which the Quran was revealed, containing Laylat al-Qadr which is better than a thousand months. Fasting it with faith expiates past sins.
